floorPlans.introduction: Explore Serro 2’s published three, four and five bedroom villa plans. The total area includes the carport and terraces or balconies shown in the source schedule; it is not the plot area. Match the plan code to the villa offered.
floorPlans.note: These are the Serro 2 sheets in Emaar’s shared The Heights booklet. Plans, dimensions and landscaping are approximate and may change. A drawn pool or furnishing does not confirm its inclusion in the selected villa’s sale.
